headline: Sensex and Nifty Slide on Inflation Fears and Rising Crude Oil Prices Before Recovering

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Inflation concerns weighed heavily on broad market sentiment.
A rise in crude oil prices contributed to the market decline.
Nifty Bank dropped around 1%, putting pressure on financial stocks.
Major heavyweights like HDFC Bank and Titan Company were top losers.
whatHappening: Sensex tumbled over 400 points to hit its day low while Nifty traded near 25,100 levels.
Markets later saw a recovery of over 400 points from day lows, pushing Nifty back above 25,200.
SpiceJet shares hit a 5% upper circuit following announcement of a fundraising plan.
Q2 corporate earnings saw Gillette India profit rise 10% and Goodyear India profit jump 31%.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened lower and dropped 400 points due to inflation concerns and rising crude oil prices. HDFC Bank and Titan were key drags, while Nifty Bank slid 1%. The indices later staged a recovery from day lows while SpiceJet surged 5% on fundraising news.
